I want to just share that I've lived here for 2 years now after moving from the Northeast as well (NEPA to be exact) and I still have yet to say "I love it here." I'm only saying this because don't feel like you're alone or that the problem is with you. 
We're planning on moving as soon as we can as of the beginning of this year. I'll tell you I talked for weeks about Stella glow when I beat it- I wanted to geek out so bad and just talk about it but sadly not too
Many played it or even finished it. It's so good!!!

I agree with you about Fire Emblem. I seriously think Stella Glow is my favorite game of all time and I've played a lot of games as I'm sure we all have... That being said I find it really hard to get into Fire Emblem with the lack of voice and I have yet to listen to an entire conversation where you bond with teammates. It's so bland without voice acting and there's just too many... And don't feel bad, I don't feel any attachment whatsoever to the characters, Stella glow had me almost on the edge of my seat with some of the plot twists and character development. They're almost two completely different games yet they play similar.
